emely challenging for a network to execute, in parallel, the handover and reconfigurations of many migrating IAB nodes and served UEs. Based on the discussion in the previous sections we propose the following: Proposal 1 RAN2 should consider load balancing of some of the traffic served by an IAB node as the primary use case for the Rel-17 inter-CU migration Proposal 2 Inter-CU migration solutions should avoid massive reconfigurations and minimize the signalling load. Proposal 3 RAN2 to de-prioritize the “classic” approach for inter-donor migration, where the migrating IAB nodes and UEs are completely handed over to the target concurrently, and the connections to the source are torn down. Proposal 4 RAN2 to study inter-donor migration mechanisms the connection of top-level node to the source donor is maintained. Proposal 5 RAN2 to study inter-donor migration mechanisms where the IAB nodes and UEs that need to be migrated are gradually migrated to the target CU, in order to avoid a signalling storm.

not time-critical. Observation 2 Topology adaptation will mainly be used for load balancing, which means only a fraction of the traffic will be carried by another/new donor-node. Observation 3 Consequently, the connection to the first CU will typically be maintained even after connected to another CU. Observation 4 Inter-CU migration solutions should be transparent as far as possible and should not incur massive simultaneous reconfigurations. Observation 5 A “classic handover” on a top-level node and its descendant nodes and UEs means that 100% of the traffic carried over that node is moved to another donor. Observation 6 It will be extremely challenging for a network to execute, in parallel, the handover and reconfigurations of many migrating IAB nodes and served UEs. Based on the discussion in the previous sections we propose the following: Proposal 1 RAN2 should consider load balancing of some of the traffic served by an IAB node as the primary use case for the Rel-17 inter-CU migration Proposal 2 Inter-CU migration solutions should avoid massive reconfigurations and minimize the signalling load. Proposal 3 RAN2 to de-prioritize the “classic” approach for inter-donor migration, where the migrating IAB nodes and UEs are completely handed over to the target concurrently, and the connections to the source are torn down. Proposal 4 RAN2 to study inter-donor migration mechanisms the connection of top-level node to the source donor is maintained. Proposal 5 RAN2 to study inter-donor migration mechanisms where the IAB nodes and UEs that need to be migrated are gradually migrated to the target CU, in order to avoid a signalling storm.

Discussion on Discard -Nokia indicates that capturing the discard agreements has been done at top level, but some have considered it should be on either power saving or capacity level. LGE thinks it’s OK to have at top level. Lenovo and vivo agrees. -Ericsson thinks discard and other information in 5.1 (XR awareness) affects both capacity and power saving. So should put it to those sections. Keep discard description at XR awareness (we assume it may impact both capacity and power saving). Can re-consider based on SI progress. Discuss in the next meeting how we handle overlaps between XR awareness and capacity/power saving enhancements. -Nokia explains RAN1 is going to provide text to TR. Is expected to send LS to RAN2 on what they have discussed. Probably comes only in the next meeting. No documents should be submitted to 8.5.3. Please submit to 8.5.3.x
